app.name: Star Catcher
app.short_description: Tilt to catch falling stars! Up to 4 players.
app.long_description: Hold your Wiimote sideways and tip it like a steering wheel to slide your basket. Catch falling stars; rainbow stars are worth 5. Storm clouds make your basket slow and wobbly for a moment. The D-pad steers too. Rounds last 60 seconds. Up to four players. Press HOME to quit.
